name: billing-dispute
summary: Customer disputed a duplicate charge on their latest statement. Agent confirmed the duplicate, issued a refund to the original payment method and explained it takes 3 to 5 business days.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, my name is [NAME]. I was charged twice on my last statement.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Let me pull up your account and take a look.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: This is the second time this has happened. It's really frustrating.

turns.speaker: AGENT_ASSISTANT
turns.text: Caller frustration is rising. Acknowledge the repeat issue and offer a refund.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I completely understand. I can see the duplicate charge and I'm refunding it now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you. How long will that take?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It goes back to your original payment method within three to five business days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Great, that works. Thanks for sorting it out so quickly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything. Have a good day.

name: cancellation-escalation
summary: Customer wanted to cancel after repeated service outages and asked for a manager. Agent escalated to a supervisor, who offered a one month credit; the customer agreed to stay.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks for calling support, how can I help?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I want to cancel my service. It has gone down three times this week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I ask what happened during the outages?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Nothing worked for hours. I'm done. Let me speak to a manager.

turns.speaker: AGENT_ASSISTANT
turns.text: High frustration and an escalation request. Offer a supervisor and consider a retention credit.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Of course. I'm bringing my supervisor onto the call now.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks for waiting. I can offer a full month of credit for the trouble.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: A month of credit? Fine, but it needs to stop happening.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood. Our network team has fixed the root cause in your area.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay. I'll stay for now. Thanks for listening.

name: password-reset
summary: Customer was locked out of their online account. Agent verified identity, sent a password reset link and confirmed the customer could sign in.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello, you're through to support. What can I do for you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I can't sign in to my account. It says my password is wrong.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No problem. Can you confirm the email on the account?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, it's [EMAIL].

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I've sent a reset link to that address.

turns.speaker: AGENT_ASSISTANT
turns.text: Suggest the knowledge article: How to reset your password.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Got it. Okay, I'm in. That was easy.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Glad to hear it. Anything else today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, thank you!

name: new-plan-inquiry
summary: Customer asked about upgrading to a plan with more data. Agent compared two plans and scheduled the upgrade from the next billing cycle.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I keep running out of data. What are my options?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We have two plans with more data. One doubles your allowance and one is unlimited.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: How much more is the unlimited one?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's ten more per month, and you'd keep your current number and contract.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That sounds good. Can it start next month?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Absolutely, I've scheduled it from your next billing cycle.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Perfect, thanks a lot.
